$comment: Who gets a brief. Each audience gets its own brief each day, built only
from the mailboxes assigned to it — one person's mail never appears in
The KEY must match a value of the extraction schema's `action_owner`
enum ('jason' | 'moet'), because the brief's 'Needs you today' section is
the items where action_owner equals the audience. Adding a third person
means adding them to that enum too (packages/extraction/src/schema.ts).
`deliverTo` is the 07:00 email recipient. Leave it empty to generate the
brief without emailing it — it is still readable at /brief/<date>.
